children.text: Becca Bloom uses the popular TikTok genre of “what I eat” and “come with me” videos to post the making of her cat’s breakfast. By opening with “Plate my cat’s breakfast with me,” she creates an expectation of a simple, everyday routine that viewers will easily recognize. This genre choice is rhetorically important because Bloom uses a familiar format to display her extraordinary life. She prepares the meal in a calm and casual manner, treating this lavish act a routine task. Her purpose is therefore not only showing what she feeds her cat, but to make her luxurious lifestyle feel entertaining, approachable and casual. The contrast between the ordinary genre and extravagance shown by Bloom encourages viewers to watch to see how her cat’s breakfast differs from their own.

Bloom immediately establishes her wealthy persona through the visual details in her video. As she begins plating her cat’s breakfast on decorative chargers, her floral outfit paired with noticeable jewelry, including her Van Cleef necklaces and other luxury pieces, signal wealth. These visual choices appeal to ethos by reinforcing her established image as a luxury lifestyle influencer. Instead of verbally explaining her financial status, she relies on visual modality formed through her appearance and setting to communicate it. This is also an affordance provided by TikTok’s visual format, allowing viewers to quickly recognize these features of her video without additional explanation. This presentation strengthens Bloom’s credibility as a luxury influencer.

When Bloom states that her “chef also made Oscar this tuna bone broth blend,” she uses a casual tone to present an extraordinary level of wealth. Having a chef prepare a meal for her cat is likely far removed from the experiences of most viewers, making the detail a subtle expression of privilege. However, Bloom delivers the statement without emphasis, presenting it as another step in preparing her cat’s breakfast. This strengthens her ethos as someone accustomed to an exceptionally luxurious life. Bloom also reinforces her broader message of presenting a lavish lifestyle through a seemingly ordinary persona.
